---
title: Native Calendar API protection
description: How native calendar preference requests are authenticated and routed.
updatedAt: '2026-10-31'
---

Native apps read and update calendar preferences through the Web API. Requests
carry the user's own session token and require verified multi-factor
authentication; no browser session is involved. The shared calendar settings
logic applies the verified actor and workspace permissions.

For user-facing behavior, see [Native calendar preferences](/platform/features/native-calendar-preferences).

Operational detail for these controls is maintained internally and is not published, because this repository is open source and published thresholds or rejection rules would help attackers.
